title: Defendable Receipt Envelope v1
description: The canonical hash-chained receipt envelope for the Defendable house. Supersedes defendable-receipt-v0.1 (checksummed-only draft). Reference implementation: open-defendable/reference/defendable_receipt.py. Spec: open-defendable/RECEIPT-SCHEMA.md. SHA-256 establishes content-integrity and chain-order ONLY.

schema.description: Envelope schema id + version. Always defendable.receipt/v1.

receipt_id.description: DCR-{seq:06d}-{hex8}. Legacy rcpt_{uuid} ids are accepted in-chain during migration but not minted.

receipt_type.description: House type. The matching payload.schema carries the type detail.

chain_id.description: Which chain this receipt belongs to. 'org:{org_id}' for per-org chains (Cloud), 'house' for the single-tenant spine chain (Router).

seq.description: Monotonic sequence within chain_id. Genesis is 0. No gaps.

parent_hash.description: The receipt_sha256 of the prior receipt in this chain. Genesis parent is 64 zeros.

subject.description: What this receipt is about. Nulls allowed for fields that don't apply.

amount_usd.description: Money moved/metered as a 2-decimal string ('6.00'), never a float. Omit/null if none.

payload.description: Type-specific body. MUST carry payload.schema (e.g. defendable.eval-receipt/v1). Additional fields allowed.

metadata.description: Free-form, non-load-bearing context. Never store secrets here.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical body (the full receipt minus receipt_sha256). Appended after hashing. seq + parent_hash ARE inside the hashed body.

$comment: Canonicalization: sorted keys, separators (",",":"), UTF-8, money as 2dp strings, datetimes as ISO-8601. Verify: strip receipt_sha256, canonicalize, SHA-256, compare; then confirm parent_hash == prior receipt's receipt_sha256. Migration: readers MUST also accept the legacy field name 'checksum_sha256' until the Router cutover completes (RECEIPT-SCHEMA.md §7).
